title: Mio from parts: head and body generated separately, joined and rigged
question: Is the parts model (a11) closer to the picture than meshy-single, and worth building on?

options.label: a01
options.note: Parts: head = Meshy image-to-3D (latest model, no remesh, textured in the same task, image enhancement off, 4k texture; 30 credits) from the head cut of the target picture; body = the same settings from the headless body cut, pose_mode a-pose asked (Meshy kept her arms down; 30 credits). Assembly: body scaled by its sleeve-to-sleeve width against the picture, head by its hair width, hair top where it is in the picture, neck centred on the body's neck. Nothing trimmed: Meshy closed the hood up round the missing head, so the hood swallows her chin and the green under the jaw.

options.label: a02
options.note: a01 plus one change: body vertices above the picture's collar line (850 px) across the whole hair width deleted. Chin and green hem show, but there are see-through holes beside the neck and white flecks.

options.label: a03
options.note: a02 with the trim narrowed to the face width (1400-1680 px). Smaller holes under her right jaw (image left).

options.label: a04
options.note: a02 with the trim narrowed to the neck only (1470-1610 px). No holes, but the hood sides cover the green hem again.

options.label: a05
options.note: a03 plus a dark band (hood lining) round the back of the neck, open 35° each side at the front. It sat in front of the green underside of the back hair and covered it.

options.label: a06
options.note: a05 with the band open 80° each side. Still in front of the green.

options.label: a07
options.note: a03 plus a flat dark card just behind the back hair, from the collar up to 740 px, instead of the band. Green hem visible, holes filled. Rigged: in the live viewer.

options.label: a08
options.note: Same head, Smart Topology body (4,000 faces) instead, same trim and card as a07. The low-poly body has an open V-neck like the picture; the trim tore holes in its big faces.

options.label: a09
options.note: Smart Topology head (meshy-t2, 3,000 faces; 15 credits) on the Smart Topology body, a07's trim and card. The low-poly head loses the face: the nose juts and the eyelashes stick out as spikes.

options.label: a10
options.note: a08 without the trim (the Smart Topology body's collar already sits at the neck). Closest to the picture so far. Rigged: in the live viewer.

options.label: a11
options.note: a10 with the dark card one-sided, so it no longer shows over the hair from behind. Rigged, 104k faces in the viewer (head decimated from 1.86M faces; the stills use the full head). White flecks at the hair's back hem remain.
